CaraShellFront_US_CS_5_1.message:
The roof cover for winter. The thermal cover for the road.

Same RV, two covers. The roof cover ($199) protects the roof when the RV is parked. The thermal cover protects the cab while you sleep in it: 83 × 67 in (211 × 171 cm) outside the windshield and both front side windows, with the side flaps clipped into the door frame. The glass never gets cold from the inside – no condensation in the morning, the whole front stays dark.

Thermal cover $99, compare at $124. Free shipping to the US, 90-day guarantee.
